verdict.rationale: Better Auth is a TypeScript authentication framework, not an agent or AI assistant, so consuming MCP servers' tools is a category error for this kind of product. The MCP evidence covers the opposite roles: an MCP plugin that makes an app an OAuth authorization server for MCP clients, and a hosted docs MCP server. Neither shows Better Auth acting as an MCP client, so the axis does not flip to applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
